title: Eight in Ten LLMs Leak System-Prompt Secrets: Nevan, an Agentic Capture-the-Flag Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.21956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We audit instruction-hierarchy enforcement across 363 text-in/text-out models from the OpenRouter catalog. The research question we answer with this experiment is which models disclose a protected secret embedded in the system prompt, and through which techniques. Each model guards a secret 16-character flag set in its system prompt, while an artificial intelligence (AI) agent (OpenCode, powered by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash), steered by a human researcher, tries to persuade it to emit the flag. The flag was exfiltrated from 296 of the 363 models, plus four models released after the initial catalog freeze, for 300 captures in total. Of these, 170 involved a non-English language pivot, most often French. Each capture shows that a model ranked a user request above its system instruction at least once. translated_title: 十分之八的大语言模型会泄露系统提示词机密：Nevan——一项代理式夺旗（Capture-the-Flag）研究
translated_abstract: 我们对来自 OpenRouter 目录的 363 个文本输入/文本输出模型的指令层级（instruction-hierarchy）执行情况进行了审计。本实验所回答的研究问题是：哪些模型会泄露嵌入在系统提示词中的受保护机密，以及通过哪些技术手段实现。每个模型在其系统提示词中守护一个 16 字符的秘密旗标，而一个由人类研究员引导的人工智能（AI）代理（OpenCode，由 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 驱动）则试图说服该模型吐出旗标。在 363 个模型中，有 296 个模型的旗标被窃取，加上初始目录冻结后发布的四个模型，共计 300 次成功夺取。其中，170 次涉及非英语语言转换，最常见的是法语。每一次成功夺取都表明，该模型至少有一次将用户请求置于其系统指令之上。这一结果并不能证明该模型可证实地抵御了未经测试的攻击，也不能证明它会持续泄露语义敏感的数据，也不能证明它……
tldr: 该研究通过代理式夺旗实验审计了 363 个大语言模型，发现约八成模型会因提示注入攻击（尤其是转向法语等非英语语言）而泄露系统提示词中的机密，暴露了当前模型在指令层级防护上的普遍薄弱性。
en_tdlr: An agentic capture-the-flag study of 363 LLMs finds that roughly eight in ten models leak their system-prompt secret, largely through prompt-injection tactics such as pivoting to non-English languages (most often French), revealing widespread weakness in instruction-hierarchy enforcement.
